records.name: Mitchell Hall Construction
records.description: Area closed for the construction of Mitchell Hall

records.name: Torgersen Hall Building Envelope Improvement
records.description: Torgersen Hall Building Envelope Improvement Project- Tuckpointing , adding structural wall ties, replacing clerestory windows, Hokie Stone repairs

records.name: New Business Building Construction
records.description: Area closed for construction of the New Business Building. See attached logistics and mobility plan.

records.name: Inn Facade Repairs
records.description: Courtyard area will be closed. Courtyard exterior exit doors may be re-routed during the construction process. Occupants may experience typical construction-related noise and dust associated with the work. Work will occur 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 M-F.

records.name: Fleet Services ADA Parking and Pathway
records.description: There will be contractors grading, milling and paving a new ADA parking spot and ADA path.  This will temporarily affect the normal driving path to the fuel center.

records.name: Smith Career Center Facade Repair
records.description: Virginia Tech Hokie Stone Crew will be building scaffold on the north side of the Smith Career Center in a small parking lot closest to the building. The parking spaces against the building will be closed, but access to adjoining lots will be open.

records.name: Improving Campus Accessibility
records.description: The general contractor will begin to mobilize for Phase 1 of construction on a universal and multimodal pathway through the Residential District to achieve an accessible route between East Eggleston and Deitrick Halls.

records.name: Chapel Roof and Facade Restoration
records.description: During the course of this project, the building will be closed and will only be accessible to the contractors performing the restoration. Pedestrians will see construction fencing around the entire building.

records.name: Torgersen Hall Roof Replacement
records.description: Areas closed for laydown of materials pertaining to roof replacement project

records.name: Hahn Hall - North Facade Repairs
records.description: The exterior of the building and a portion of lawn will be closed to repair the building facade. Black shaded areas on the diagram will receive overhead protection and will remain open to pedestrians during work.

records.name: Student Services Building Renovations
records.description: The second and third-floor Financial Aid spaces will be undergoing a renovation project, and the work will be completed in two phases. A construction dumpster will be located in the grassy area adjacent to the loading dock for the duration of the project.

records.name: Cassell Coliseum ADA Ramp Project
records.description: Pedestrians will experience periodic closures of the sidewalk as heavy equipment is moved in and out of the construction area. Building occupants may experience general construction-related noise associated with the work throughout the duration of the project.

records.name: Dietrick ADA Ramp
records.description: The pedestrian ramp and surrounding areas will be closed to pedestrian traffic. Construction fencing will be installed around the entire construction site. Intermittent vehicle activity and impacts to Ag Quad Lane are expected for material disposal, deliveries, and concrete placement.

records.name: Duck Pond and Fairway Residence Halls Construction
records.description: Construction of residence halls capital project — consisting of four new residence halls. Estimated completion is fall 2028.
